summary: DLMF 24.4 Basic Properties: Let P(x) denote any polynomial in x , and after expanding set (B(x))^{n}=B_{n}\left(x\right) and…
body: NIST DLMF section 24.4 (Basic Properties) says: "Let P(x) denote any polynomial in x , and after expanding set (B(x))^{n}=B_{n}\left(x\right) and (E(x))^{n}=E_{n}\left(x\right) . Then For these results and also connections with the umbral calculus see Gessel ( 2003 ) . For the relation of Bernoulli numbers to the Riemann zeta function see § 25.6 , and to the Eulerian numbers see ( 26.14.11 )." Equation 24.4.18 on the page has alt text "B_{n}\left(mx\right)=m^{n-1}\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}B_{n}\left(x+\frac{k}{m}\right).". Equation 24.4.19 on the page has alt text "E_{n}\left(mx\right)=-\frac{2m^{n}}{n+1}\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}(-1)^{k}B_{n+1}\left(x% +\frac{k}{m}\right),". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
